title.zh: 将南甘马粦省 Goa市镇 Catagbacan描笼涯新 Partido 中学的名称变更为新 Partido 国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of New Partido High School in Barangay Catagbacan, Municipality of Goa, Province of Camarines Sur to New Partido National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of New Partido High School in Barangay Catagbacan, Municipality of Goa, Province of Camarines Sur to New Partido National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông New Partido tại Barangay Catagbacan, Thị trấn Goa, Tỉnh Camarines Sur thành Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia New Partido
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา New Partido ในบารังไกย์ Catagbacan, เทศบาล Goa, จังหวัด Camarines Sur เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ New Partido
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas New Partido di Barangay Catagbacan, Kotamadya Goa, Provinsi Camarines Sur menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional New Partido
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah New Partido di Barangay Catagbacan, Perbandaran Goa, Wilayah Camarines Sur menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan New Partido

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2024/ra_12084_2024.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of New Partido High School in Barangay Catagbacan, Municipality of Goa, Province of Camarines Sur is hereby changed to New Partido National High School.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following its publication in the Official Gazette or in a national newspaper of general circulation.
